<!-- pr-reviewer: 991d34b3f51371920eed203054cf22a17c05597e -->
Reviewer: wopr pool job review-4184 (pool metadata unset), GPT-6 (Codex), mkinney/seat unset; did not write or refresh this PR.

Ready for the maintainer to merge. No blocking finding.

This is a SAFETY-tier review. I read the complete diff and checked the laws from upstream/main `e6849c5aea183b81135c8143955cc8c88a429a89`.
The local trial merge is `68ff1bc07fe746c475255248a355eb6a0fe441e2`. Its first parent is the PR head above.

The default tool call selects D1. The stated `tool-number` rule selects D equal to T.
Unknown machine-file rules are refused. A retract cancels the tool offset with D0 and states G0.
A later section selects its D again before motion. The first traverse then states its clearance height.
These rules agree with sections 4.4 and 6.6 of the [Siemens Fundamentals manual](https://cache.industry.siemens.com/dl/files/241/109763241/att_971137/v1/840Dsl_fundamentals_progr_man_1218_en-US.pdf).

I checked every changed golden line. The changes match the body under "Goldens moved".
They change the D word, the final retract, and the explain text. No coordinate or cutting-feed value changed.
The PR changes no file under `crates/ui`. The screenshot requirement does not apply.

**Local build and tests**

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` | 855 steps; 0 failed; 0 stalled; 52.8 minutes |
| `cargo xtask gate light` | 6 steps; 0 failed; 0 stalled |
| `cargo clippy -j 32 -p camcraft-post -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` | Pass |
| `sinumerik_safe_retract` | 7 passed |
| `program_comments` | 4 passed |
| `example_catalog` | 43 passed; 4 ignored |
| `example_catalog_adaptive`, `example_catalog_edge_work` | 1 passed each |
| UI library tests, from `crates/ui` | 1712 passed; 8 ignored |

The quick gate built the selected post and app test binaries before it ran them.
Every test step that ran passed. No bare-main failure comparison was needed.
The full heavy lanes were not run. This P3 review requires the targeted tests and the light lane.

**Extra suites run**

I found the tests that read the changed golden directories. The quick gate ran these suites by name:

- App: `conformance` (7), `program_units` (7), `control_comp` (9), `wear_comp` (5), `probe_op` (12), `solid_law_goldens` (7).
- Post: `script_sinumerik` (13), `bore_cycle` (9), `ream_cycle` (5), `explain_remaining` (14), `wcs_flip_dialects` (9), `arc_planes` (7), `probe_dialects` (13).
- Post: `comp` (9). The three `example_catalog*` suites above also passed.

The numbers in parentheses are passed tests. No importer code or model fixture changed, so the extra importer selection does not apply.

**Mutations**

I ran the CLI against copies of the post in `/tmp`. I used the same-tool, two-section home stream from the regression test.
The checks reproduce the PR's regression assertions.

1. Restore D equal to T: RED. The D1 tool-call assertion detects D12.
2. Remove G0 and D0 from `retractZ`: RED. The retract assertion detects both omissions.
3. Remove the D reselection after a home move: RED. The assertion detects the missing D before motion.

The unmodified post was GREEN for all three checks. Its first move after home was Z-only at the stated clearance.
The repository source was not changed for these checks. The worktree is clean.

Requested before merge: none. No real 840D control was exercised.
The environment has no `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` or `CLAUDE_JOB_DIR`; `review-4184` identifies this review task.
The warm worktree and branch remain in place. The author is qsmits, so I leave the ready state unchanged.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
left for the maintainer: check 6 skip - this PR changes posted G-code (assets/posts/sinumerik.cps). Counted clean SAFETY-tier review at 991d34b3f (wopr pool, GPT-6 (Codex), mkinney); merge by hand.
